judged_text: The `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present?` guard was dropped from `expandable_first_post?` without a replacement (no `EmbeddableHost.exists?` check), so the method now returns true based solely on `embed_truncate?` and `has_topic_embed?`. On a site where all EmbeddableHost rows are deleted (or a fresh install that previously used topic embeds), first posts of topic-embedded topics remain expandable even though embedding is no longer permitted — the old setting presence acted as a kill-switch that this iteration deleted without human sign-off.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic.rb`, `expandable_first_post?` changed from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to only `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (no `EmbeddableHost.exists?`/similar replacement). The new implementation ignores whether any allowed embeddable hosts are configured (now stored in the `embeddable_hosts` table), so a topic with a `TopicEmbed` can still be treated as expandable when `embed_truncate` is enabled even if all `EmbeddableHost` rows are removed and embedding requests are blocked elsewhere (`EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` now checks `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`). That is a behavior change/regression relative to the previous kill-switch guard.
